panels.description: Orange > 60 s, red > 5 min or no data for a day ("stopped"). Trigger is written on change and hourly, so it turns orange only after 1.5 h.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM acc WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day')) AS "Accelerator",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM pps WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day')) AS "PPS",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM magnet WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day')) AS "Magnet",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM cryomag WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day')) AS "SHS PS",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM field WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND name = 'shs1')) AS "Probe SHS1",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM field WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND name = 'shs2')) AS "Probe SHS2",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM field WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND name = 'd5')) AS "Probe D5",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM ess WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day')) AS "ESS",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM target WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day')) AS "Target",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM slit WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day')) AS "Slit",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM omniace WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day')) AS "Omniace",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM gl840 WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND ip_address LIKE 'logger1.%')) AS "Logger1",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM gl840 WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND ip_address LIKE 'logger2.%')) AS "Logger2",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM massflow WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day' AND hostname = '192.168.20.14')) AS "Massflow",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (SELECT max(timestamp) FROM trigger WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '1 day')) AS "Trigger"
SELECT opr_mode FROM acc ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT mr_power FROM acc ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT syim_power FROM acc ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT mr_p3_intensity FROM acc ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT NULLIF(sx_duty, 'NaN') FROM acc ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT NULLIF(sx_ext_effi, 'NaN') FROM acc ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description: Set / monitor current. Dev = (|Mon| - Set) / Set, shown when Set > 1 A. Orange beyond ±1 %, red beyond ±5 %.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.name AS "Magnet",
  (l.magnet_data->m.key->>'cset')::float AS "Set",
  abs((l.magnet_data->m.key->>'cmon')::float) AS "Mon",
  l.magnet_data->m.key->>'pol' AS "Pol",
  CASE WHEN abs((l.magnet_data->m.key->>'cset')::float) > 1
       THEN 100 * (abs((l.magnet_data->m.key->>'cmon')::float) - (l.magnet_data->m.key->>'cset')::float)
                / (l.magnet_data->m.key->>'cset')::float END AS "Dev"
FROM (SELECT magnet_data FROM magnet ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) l,
     (VALUES ('BSM1', 'BSM1', 0), ('K1.8 D1', 'AK18D1', 1), ('CM1', 'K18CM1', 2), ('CM2', 'K18CM2', 3), ('K1.8BR D5', 'K18BRD5', 4)) AS m(name, key, ord)
ORDER BY m.ord
